INDIA'S COAL IMPORTS
In Jan-Aug 2026, global seaborne
coal loadings increased by +1.7% y-
o-y to 866.8 mln t (excluding
cabotage), based on vessel tracking
data from AXS Marine. In Jan-Aug 2026, exports from
Indonesia declined by -5.2% y-o-y to
296.3 mln tonnes, whilst from
Australia were up by +4.9% y-o-y to
233.9 mln t.
